stem: In one month only 1 of 800 Business Care businesses cancelled, so that month's logo churn was 0.125%, and an LTV built on that month alone came out at €19,200. What is the best fix?

options.text: Leave out gross margin, to balance out the very low churn of that month
Divide by the yearly churn rate instead, since it is a larger number
Use the average churn of the last 6 months, as Voltmarkt's convention does
Keep that month's churn, since the most recent month is always the most accurate
